notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
[b]NECROMANCIA'S FIRST CONTENT UPDATE IS HERE![/b]

Watch the update trailer here!
[previewyoutube=BcgUfyXipAY;full][/previewyoutube]

This update includes a [i]plethora [/i]of new features and bug fixes INCLUDING:

ːsteamthumbsupː [b]SAVING/LOADING[/b]
ːsteamthumbsupː [b]COSMETICS[/b]
ːsteamthumbsupː [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
ːsteamthumbsupː [b]REVAMPED ALL LEVELS[/b]
ːsteamthumbsupː [b]LEVEL SELECT HUB[/b]
ːsteamthumbsupː [b]VIDEO AND AUDIO SETTINGS[/b]
ːsteamthumbsupː [b]MANY BUG FIXES[/b]
ːsteamthumbsdownː [strike]REMOVED JUANOBRINE[/strike]

Here is a look at the new LEVEL HUB! You can access it at any time to play levels you have unlocked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022836/2cc58a9edf788e5eb762325df7495e0f49e66f1e.png[/img]


Enjoy trying on 6 cosmetic hats, each discovered throughout the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022836/a5db60098d3ff5167273dd57d235cb70a0b2fc8b.png[/img]

We hope to release more NECROMANCIA content before the end of the year, so STAY TUNED!

notes.title: [V1.0.1] Initial bug-fixes!
notes.content:
[h1][b]NECROMANCIA IS HERE!!![/b][/h1]
[b]Necromancia Update[/b]!!! 
Today is release day and with our release comes...

BUGS!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022836/8c6be42a89bbdde401ad27b554d5554e307f8307.png[/img]
[i]Juan Dingus enjoying his summer. Annoying minions omitted.[/i]


[h2][i]Changes:[/i][/h2]
-Fixed game-breaking level 2 bug
-Fixed brown minion detection/general collision
-Improved hit detection for minions
-Code improvements



[h3][u]Future:[/u][/h3]
For the future, we're constantly working on bug fixes and quality of life improvements. Content-wise, we're looking at expanding the story to include additional creative levels and soon, possibly even... [spoiler]Achievements ;)[/spoiler]!!

Have a great summer necromancers!
